an4.201:1.1: “Monks, I will teach you the person of no integrity, the person of less integrity than the person of no integrity,
an4.201:1.2: the person of integrity, & the person of more integrity than the person of integrity.
an4.201:1.3: Listen & pay careful attention. I will speak.”
an4.201:1.4: “As you say, lord,” the monks responded to the Blessed One.
an4.201:2.1: “And which, monks, is the person of no integrity?
an4.201:2.2: There is the case where a certain individual is one who takes life, takes what is not given [steals], engages in sexual misconduct, tells lies, and takes distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness.
an4.201:2.3: This is called a person of no integrity.
an4.201:3.1: “And which is the person of less integrity than the person of no integrity?
an4.201:3.2: There is the case where a certain individual himself is one who takes life and he encourages another in undertaking the taking of life.
an4.201:3.3: He himself is one who takes what is not given and he encourages another in undertaking the taking of what is not given.
an4.201:3.4: He himself is one who engages in sexual misconduct and he encourages another in undertaking sexual misconduct.
an4.201:3.5: He himself is one who tells lies and he encourages another in undertaking the telling of lies.
an4.201:3.6: He himself is one who takes distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness and he encourages another in undertaking the taking of distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness.
an4.201:3.7: This is called a person of less integrity than the person of no integrity.
an4.201:4.1: “And which is the person of integrity?
an4.201:4.2: There is the case where a certain individual abstains from taking life, abstains from taking what is not given, abstains from sexual misconduct, abstains from telling lies, and abstains from taking distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness.
an4.201:4.3: This is called a person of integrity.
an4.201:5.1: “And which is the person of more integrity than the person of integrity?
an4.201:5.2: There is the case where a certain individual himself abstains from taking life and he encourages another in undertaking abstinence from taking life.
an4.201:5.3: He himself abstains from taking what is not given and he encourages another in undertaking abstinence from taking what is not given.
an4.201:5.4: He himself abstains from sexual misconduct and he encourages another in undertaking abstinence from sexual misconduct.
an4.201:5.5: He himself abstains from telling lies and he encourages another in undertaking abstinence from telling lies.
an4.201:5.6: He himself abstains from taking distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness and he encourages another in undertaking abstinence from taking distilled & fermented drinks that cause heedlessness.
an4.201:5.7: This is called a person of more integrity than the person of integrity.”
